تشتعلن (form VIII)
# تَشْتَعِلْنَ (taštaʕilna) /taʃ.ta.ʕil.na/: second-person feminine plural non-past active indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِشْتَعَلَ (ištaʕala)
# تُشْتَعَلْنَ (tuštaʕalna) /tuʃ.ta.ʕal.na/: second-person feminine plural non-past passive indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِشْتَعَلَ (ištaʕala)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
